title: Langflow unauthenticated RCEs exploited in the wild but not in CISA KEV; Metasploit ships six Langflow modules
why: VulnCheck, F5 Labs and others report in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-0768; F5 Labs says it is not in CISA KEV, and the KEV feed has added nothing since. Metasploit added Langflow modules on Oct 23.
action: Take Langflow off the internet (put it behind a VPN or auth proxy), set a non-default secret key, disable AUTO_LOGIN, and rotate every secret configured in flows.
product: Langflow up to 1.4.2 unauthenticated; code exec persists in later versions with default AUTO_LOGIN (no complete fix per Pruva)

title: Oracle PeopleSoft PeopleTools unauth RCE: ShinyHunters (UNC6240) renews mass exploitation with a URL-encoded WAF bypass (KEV)
why: Not ahead: CISA added CVE-2026-35273 to KEV on June 12, 2026, so it is already tracked.
action: Apply Oracle's CVE-2026-35273 Security Alert patch, or disable EMHub/remove PSEMHUB. Do not rely on string-match WAF rules. Hunt for JSP web shells and MeshAgent under the PeopleSoft service account.
product: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools 8.61, 8.62 (and older unsupported); fixed via June 10, 2026 Security Alert

title: Magento PolyShell unauthenticated file upload: Sansec ties it to 953-store JS-loader campaign; no sign of CISA KEV listing
why: Sansec (via OTX, Oct 2026) and SecurityWeek report that a group injected JavaScript loaders into 953 stores. In March, 471 Magento stores were infected through PolyShell (CVE-2026-48356), and over 100 more had files uploaded through PolyShell or SessionReaper. A public PoC is on GitHub. Pentest-Tools lists CVE-2026-48356 as not in the CISA KEV catalog, and no KEV addition has appeared. SessionReaper CVE-2025-54236 is a separate, older flaw. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Apply the APSB26-73 2026-jul isolated patch, deny all access to pub/media/custom_options/, then scan the media dirs and CMS blocks for uploaded PHP files and injected loaders.
product: Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source 2.4.9, 2.4.8-p5, 2.4.7-p10, 2.4.6-p15, 2.4.5-p17, 2.4.4-p18 and earlier (fixed by 2026-jul isolated patch, APSB26-73)

title: Splunk Enterprise unauthenticated RCE via Patroni REST API on search head cluster members: public PoC with mass-exploit mode
why: Horizon3 notes a public GitHub PoC, and Splunk reports no exploitation. CISA SSVC marks exploitation as none, and it is not in CISA KEV (no KEV additions since Oct 23).
action: Upgrade to Splunk Enterprise 10.4.3/10.2.7 and block the Patroni REST port (~8008) from untrusted networks.
product: Splunk Enterprise 10.4.0-10.4.2 and 10.2.0-10.2.6 search head cluster members (fixed 10.4.3 / 10.2.7); 10.0.x and 9.4.x not affected

title: Pillow EPS/Ghostscript argument injection to command execution (CVSS 9.2), fixed in Pillow 13.0.0
why: Advisory includes a public reproduction; not in CISA KEV and no in-the-wild reports as of Oct 23. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Upgrade Pillow to 13.0.0+ and remove Ghostscript from image-processing hosts that do not need EPS.

title: Brotli decoder OOB write (Node2Shell): Microsoft publishes MSRC advisory and out-of-band .NET fixes
why: No longer ahead: MSRC published CVE-2026-111497 on Oct 25 with out-of-band .NET updates.
action: Install .NET 8.0.33/9.0.22/10.0.14, rebuild self-contained apps and container images, and update Node.js and Bun along with every other bundled Brotli copy.

title: Linux kernel skb_zerocopy local root (ZDI-CAN-33367): public PoC bypasses Dirty Frag fix; fix still unmerged, no CVE
why: A working root PoC is public (TuxCare and Sysdig). The netdev patch has been reviewed but not merged, there is no CVE, and it is not in CISA KEV. AlmaLinux kernels are in testing and KernelCare has a patch for EL10.
action: Block esp4/esp6 modules or set user.max_user_namespaces=0 where possible; install distro kernel updates as they ship.
product: Linux kernel since 3.14 (skb_zerocopy), incl. kernels with Dirty Frag CVE-2026-43284 fix

title: CERT-UA: Dahua cameras/NVRs compromised via Easy4IP serial guessing plus old KEV auth bypasses (CVE-2021-33044/33045)
why: Not ahead: CVE-2021-33044/33045 have been in CISA KEV since 2024.
action: Disable P2P/Easy4IP on Dahua devices, update the firmware, and remove unknown user accounts.
product: Dahua IP cameras and recorders with pre-mid-2021 firmware and Easy4IP P2P enabled

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: Microsoft publishes analysis (Storm-0940); LiteLLM blames key exposed in May
why: No longer ahead: Microsoft Security published a technical analysis on Oct 23 attributing the compromise to Storm-0940, so Microsoft is tracking it.
action: Find any install of litellm==1.107.0 or its images and rotate every credential reachable from those hosts.

title: GitLab unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex bug (CVSS 10): Ruby ships upstream fixes; any Ruby app compiling untrusted regex affected
why: Vendor-confirmed unauthenticated RCE, now widened to any Ruby app compiling attacker-controlled regex; THN: none of the four GitLab CVEs in CISA KEV as of Oct 23; no public PoC or ITW. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab to the Oct 21 releases and Ruby runtimes to 4.0.9/3.4.12/3.3.13; audit Regexp.new on user input.
product: GitLab CE/EE 7.0+ (fixed 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6 and backports); Ruby before 4.0.9 / 3.4.12 / 3.3.13

title: Unpatched Linux KSMBD RCEs (ZDI-CAN-33774 pre-auth, ZDI-CAN-33549 SMB Direct, CVSS 9.0) public on LKML with no mainline fix
why: Detailed ZDI reports leaked to public LKML; no mainline fix, no CVE, not in CISA KEV; public PoCs show crash/leak only. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Unload/disable ksmbd where not needed and block TCP 445 from untrusted networks.

title: HPE Aruba AOS-8/AOS-10: eight max-severity unauthenticated auth-bypass/RCE flaws among 72 CVEs (HPESBNW05162)
why: Vendor advisory for max-severity unauthenticated flaws in widely deployed edge gear; no PoC/ITW yet and not in CISA KEV. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Upgrade AOS-8/AOS-10 controllers and gateways to the fixed releases and restrict management interfaces.

title: NGINX heap overflows/UAF (CVSS4 9.2) allow unauthenticated DoS and possible RCE in specific configurations
why: F5 out-of-band advisory K000163408 and oss-security disclosure of unauthenticated memory corruption in the most deployed reverse proxy; no in-the-wild use, no public PoC and not in CISA KEV. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Upgrade NGINX to 1.30.6/1.31.7 (or F5 fixed builds) and review configs with nginx -T for alias/map/aio usage.
product: NGINX Open Source before 1.30.6 / 1.31.7 (ranges per CVE); NGINX Plus 37.0.0-37.0.4; Ingress Controller, Gateway Fabric, Instance Manager

title: Apache Traffic Server: unauthenticated ImageMagick argument injection in experimental magick plugin (CVSS 10) among 15 ATS fixes
why: Apache's Oct 21 advisory (forwarded to oss-security Oct 24) discloses an unauthenticated CVSS 10.0 flaw; no PoC or in-the-wild use reported and it is not in CISA KEV. Not re-searched this run; the CISA KEV feed showed no additions since the last run.
action: Upgrade ATS to 9.2.16/10.1.5/10.2.1 and disable the magick, tsmemcache and wasm experimental plugins if not needed.

title: FortiSandbox GUI unauthenticated auth bypass to command execution (CVSS 9.6, vendor E:F)
why: Fortinet advisory FG-IR-26-185 (Oct 13) and ZDI-26-771 describe an unauthenticated GUI auth bypass. NVD published the CVE on Oct 26. Fortinet's vector carries E:F (functional exploit exists) but no public exploit was found. Not in CISA KEV, while two earlier FortiSandbox bugs were added to KEV in July.
action: Upgrade FortiSandbox to 5.0.7 or 4.4.10 (migrate PaaS 4.4), and restrict the management GUI to admin networks.
product: FortiSandbox 5.0.0-5.0.6, 4.4.0-4.4.9, 4.2 all; FortiSandbox PaaS 5.0.0-5.0.6, 4.4/4.2 all (fixed 5.0.7, 4.4.10; 5.2 unaffected)

title: Tailworm: unpatched Tailscale SSH socket-forwarding flaws let one compromised node reach root on other tailnet servers (vendor acknowledges, no fix)
why: Erica Windisch (Cyberdione Labs) published 11 lab-reproduced findings on Oct 25. Tailscale's VP of Engineering said publicly that it found issues and is fixing them, but there is no bulletin, CVE or fixed version yet (the newest bulletin is TS-2026-013). Not in KEV. No in-the-wild use reported.
action: Disable port forwarding in Tailscale SSH rules (or disable Tailscale SSH on headscale, where forwarding cannot be turned off), use per-pair source-to-destination ACLs, enable Tailnet Lock, and watch Tailscale security bulletins.
product: Tailscale 1.104.2 (tested) with Tailscale SSH enabled; headscale 0.29.5

title: Wasmtime Cranelift sandbox escapes from malicious Wasm modules (CVSS 9.9, two CVEs)
why: Wasmtime maintainers published advisories (RUSTSEC-2026-0379/0380), covered by THN on Oct 26. Neither CVE is in CISA KEV as of Oct 26. GitHub has no reviewed advisory for CVE-2026-115893, so Dependabot will not alert on it. No PoC or exploitation reported.
action: Rebuild every program that embeds Wasmtime against 36.0.19, 48.0.7 or 49.0.4. Updating the CLI is not enough. Check Cargo.lock files with cargo-audit.
product: Wasmtime before 36.0.19 / 43.0.0 (CVE-2026-115889, all arches); before 36.0.19, 48.0.7, 49.0.4 (CVE-2026-115893, ARM64); unsupported lines incl. 24.x LTS get no fix
